summary: Tested iteration 18: the 4 store-count intro templates, template audience, the one-intro rule in run_auto, per-inbox signatures, the email-format checker and LinkedIn being off. Backend: new tests/test_intro_v2_iter18.py has 18 tests (live API plus unit tests on a throw-away DB). 17 pass; the 1 failure is a real minor bug (the no-domain path leaves fmt_running set). Related suites (email_templates, mailboxes, outreach): 80 pass after I updated 2 old tests that still expected 'Intro email' to be auto. Live DB check: 132 approved intro emails queued (66: 119, 67: 3, 68: 10, 65: 0). Every one is in the right store-count bucket, no brand has more than one intro, and 0 brands are still eligible, so the next run creates 0. 0 for D2C is because none of the 435 D2C prospects has an email yet. The unit test covers routing at the edges: 100 goes to 100+, 99 and 11 go to 11-99, 10/1/0/missing/null go to 1-10, D2C with 500 stores goes to D2C, brands that replied or already got the old intro are skipped, a second run makes 0, and no AI is called. Frontend (Playwright, desktop): everything requested works. No LinkedIn tab. The email-format status line and 'Check formats now' button show. The auto bar lists the 4 intros with audience labels. The audience badges for 65-68 show and template 1 shows MANUAL. Editing template 67 shows tpl-audience = stores_11_99 with ai_tailor unticked; Save sends audience in the PUT (toast: 3 queued emails updated). The signature card shows. The Admin add-inbox form has the mailbox-signature textarea. The prospect page has the prospect-check-format button. The lead page shows the lead-contacts block (4 decision makers for Raymond).

minor.issue: Returns early with $set only and never unsets fmt_running. The prospect stays marked as running until the stale cleanup in ef.run() (1 h). In that time POST /prospecting/prospects/{pid}/check-format returns 409 and the UI button stays 'Checking format…'. Fix: add '$unset': {'fmt_running': 1} to that update_one.

The LLM quota is currently used up (Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, raised as AiCreditsOut). The background task clears fmt_running but writes no fmt_checked_at or status and raises an unhandled task exception. The user gets a 'about a minute' success toast and then nothing changes, with no error shown. Data is not corrupted. Suggest storing an error state that the UI can show.

Manual click-to-send does not check the one-intro rule. A user can queue a second intro (for example 'Intro email' or another bucket's intro) for a brand that already has one queued. The prospect page shows all 5 intro templates as buttons for every contact. This may be intended for manual sends; consider warning or hiding the other intros.

If an admin changes an intro template's audience to 'all' (Every brand), it drops out of intro_ids, which only covers non-'all' audiences or kind 'intro'. It would then send to every brand that already got an intro, which breaks the one-intro rule. Consider basing intro_ids on kind (intro*) instead of audience, or blocking 'all' for intro_* kinds.

Routing only works for numeric or null store_count. A string value (e.g. '150') matches no bucket, so the brand never gets an intro. The live DB has only int or null today (1708 int, 514 null), so this is a guard for future imports.

issues: Subtitle still says 'AI tailors your email templates for each contact', but the auto intros are now sent as written (ai_tailor false).
The channel filter still offers a 'LinkedIn' option although the LinkedIn feature is switched off.

_with_signature puts the inbox signature into the HTML without escaping. Only admins can set it, so the risk is low, but '<' or '&' in a signature will render oddly

PUT /admin/mailboxes and PUT /outreach/templates use model defaults (signature='', audience='all'). Any client that leaves these fields out will silently reset them. The current frontend sends both fields.
